incident-bot: [ALERT] High preemption spike in eu-west GPU pool 'gpu-eu-main' — 90% spot node churn in 2m, inference tail latencies climbing, a subset of requests returning 503. Paging @Anya (oncall).
Anya: Acknowledged. I'm attaching initial error summary and will triage. Diving in now.
Anya: Observed 3K 503s in last 3m, p50->p95 jump from 120ms->1.8s. Autoscaler shows concurrent scale downs + spot terminations.
Devon: Any eviction messages in node logs? Can you paste the `kubectl get nodes` output?
Anya: Quick snippet:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-eu-main
NAME                     STATUS    ROLES   AGE
gpu-eu-main-12-abc       NotReady  <none>  7m
gpu-eu-main-4-def        Ready     <none>  2h
gpu-eu-main-7-ghi        NotReady  <none>  5m
```
Anya: Cloud logs show AWS ASG spot-interruption notices at ~1769135400.
Chris: Looks like spot pool got hit by a batch of terminations. Are we draining and recreating? We should avoid mass drain while autoscaler is trying to shrink.
Anya: I'm temporarily raising autoscaler min to keep buffer. Running:
```
$ aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-eu-main-asg --min-size 6
```
Anya: Also toggled `routing.policy=prefer-replicas` for critical customer traffic so heavy models fall back to dedicated pool.
support-bot: Noted — customer-facing status page updated: "Degraded performance for eu-west region, mitigation in progress." :rotating_light:
Devon: I'll start warm nodes in the reserved/dedicated pool and start live routing shift. Plan: bring 4 reserved GPUs online, reroute 10% of traffic initially.
Anya: Handing off active remediation to Devon — need to go offline for on-call rotation in 20m. Leaving runbook notes:
- current preemption window: 2-8m
- attempted auto-heal: failed due to concurrent scale-down
- mitigation: raise min, enable reserved fallback, restrict large-model routes
Devon: Got it, taking over at 1769136400. Will post updates in thread. :+1:
Devon: Provisioned 4 reserved instances, enabled fallback route. Verified that error rate dropped from 503 -> 200 within ~7m for routed traffic.
Anya: Thanks. Adding customer impact summary for post-incident analysis: ~12 active customers in eu-west saw degraded responses (inference latency > 1s) for ~22m, two had transient 503 spikes for ~8m. No data loss.
Chris: Requesting a follow-up postmortem. Propose 1hr slot tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation, SLA impact, action owner assignment.
Maria: I can schedule and invite infra, runtime, and SRE. Also opening tracking ticket RW-INF-2026 to record remediation items.
Maria: Action items I'm adding to RW-INF-2026 (initial):
- (Anya) Update autoscaler runbook: prevent concurrent scale-down during spot interruption windows. due: 2026-03-18
- (Devon) Implement standby reserved buffer policy (2x baseline) + test failover. due: 2026-03-25
- (Chris) Add alerting rule: spot-interruption-rate > 20% for 2m -> page SRE and suppress autoscaler down. due: 2026-03-17
- (Maria) Postmortem doc + customer impact statement. due: 2026-03-16
Anya: Adding small config snippet for safer autoscaler policy:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 4
  cooldown_after_spot_eviction: 300s
  prevent_scale_down_if_spot_events: true
```
Devon: I'll also add a canary test that simulates 30% spot churn and verifies fallback routing within 5m.
support-bot: Notifying Support escalation channel and drafting customer emails for affected accounts. Assigned to Maria.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Incident mitigated at 1769139300 — reserved fallback + autoscaler min bump held steady. Closing current page. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-16 10:00 UTC.
Maria: Thanks everyone. Please add any additional notes or lingering tasks here. I'll convert messages -> postmortem template and link RW-INF-2026.
Anya: Couple follow-ups I'll put in RW-INF-2026: add runbook step to pause autoscaler during mass spot-interrupt alerts, and document a routing hierarchy for heavy models.
Chris: Reminder — verify cost impact estimate for reserved buffer before finalizing policy. Devon will own the test and perf numbers.
Devon: On it. I'll post results in the postmortem doc. Closing my active tasks for this thread. :white_check_mark:
